text: Great! We quickly needed some important vaccinations (as tourists from Europe). Just reached out to the clinic via E-mail and got an appointment within 2 days. Also everything else at the clinic went very quick and smooth. Frontdesk staff and the doc were super friendly, helpfull and efficient. And (especially compared to Europe) it was very affordable.

I've used CM Mediclinic to source medication twice now. On both occasions using their online service by providing them a prescription. They follow compliance standards to the letter but make it feel easy. They are super responsive and really understand the needs of their clients. This is real genuine human to human communication and service. 6 Stars not 5!

I cut myself on vacation and realized that I had not got a tetanus vaccine prior to arriving in Chiang Mai. This Clinic was so professional, responsive, and lovely to deal with.  They do not direct bill to insurance but will provide you with a certificate to give to your insurance company. Highly recommend.

Excellent experience with CM Mediclinic!
The nurse here is very careful and also professional.
I have my own subscription from my doctor in my country.just need the help with injections from the nurse.
The doctor and nurse is very careful for the details and information required for my own medical needs . Good service .Recommend!

The professionalism and service here is at another level. The doctor spent time discussing my issue until we were both clear. The experience was actually pleasant and every staff member is well trained and personable. The best experience I’ve had in medical matters. I wish healthcare was like this in the UK.

text: An amazing experience. I met with the doctor and she listened to me and provided me with the medicines and most importantly, different options for medicines. The communication was fantastic from the beginning to the end. I highly recommend stopping here and getting medication updates.

Made an appointment on the phone for a same day consultation. Everyone speaks English very well. The nurse took my temperature and blood pressure, then the doctor saw me. Got a blood test done. The next day I got the results and a long email with a diagnosis. I had further questions and the doctor answered right away.

100% recommend
And all of this for THB 1250.

text: Just got to Chiang Mai and got some vaccines and blood tests done. They're super responsive, professional and timely. The doctor was thoughtful and willing to take the time to review previous test results with me - this is very rare! Lovely nurse and staff as well. Thank you for the great service!
Ok, simply efficient. Walked in and asked for a Drivers License Certificate exam. Left 10-15 minutes later and nothing but smiling service and Chiang Mai excellence. Add a ⭐️

I was visiting Chiang Mai for work and had to see a doctor, so I stumbled upon this place on Google. Super friendly, clean, and reasonably priced. The doctor and the nurses were very helpful and spot on with the diagnosis. Had a chat with expats there who have been following up with the clinic for a long time and they all said it’s great!

I had a bad leg injury and had to be treated for infection 2 weeks. Since it was my first time being ‘’ill’’ so far from home, i was a little bit afraid. But the doctor here and all the staff made me feel safe and that i’m in good hands. I …

We arrived here for an ART test (700thb each) required for Singapore.  Testing was completed outside with a small fan; which wasn’t blowing anywhere near our face (not sure if it’s good or not) for result purposes.

They are very freaked out about people coming there for text and won’t allow you entry; so try to plan on a day where you won’t sweat to death.

Served it’s purpose, but not sure how keen I would about ever returning.

text: Great clinic, with exceptional staff and services. Routine std testing made very easy and comfortable. A+++
The internal-medicine doctor she's the worst ever didn't help at all and I just paid twice for following up the blood results which didn't say something useful at the end

Came to take Flu vaccine that cover 4 types of influenza viruses before taking off to other country. The front staff Fai was very attentive, informative, and very helpful. The price is reasonable (I personally think it’s cheap compare to other hospital that offer the same services in Chiangmai) the services from medical practitioners was good. We didnt wait in line at all(but make sure you make an appointment in advanced) 10/10

Outstanding service.
Booking an appointment was simple, and the waiting time upon arrival was very reasonable. The receptionist was friendly and helpful. The doctor was exceptionally knowledgeable, professional, and spoke perfect English.

Above all, they were genuinely caring and understanding. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking quality care.
Very professional and very clean clinic. We very happy with the services that we got here. Highly recommend!!!

Highly recommend. Wasn't feeling great, sent an email to request an appointment. Was in there 1hour later. Perfect English and clean facilities. Very well explained and all my medications were given to me after my appointment. Great service. Thankyou

C.M. Mediclinic has a friendly, professional staff, all of whom speak excellent English. The clean, tidy, comfortable office environment is warm and welcoming. The doctor is simply outstanding. She is exceptionally knowledgeable, as well as, detailed in her analysis and explanations. She covers all of the bases and even includes things patients probably never thought. She is attentive, patient, and answers every question you have. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone who is looking for an affordable, professional, friendly, comprehensive experience.
Great Medical Clinic in Chiang Mai, very knowledgeable staff and great prices. Highly recommended 👍🏻 …

I have Epilepsy for which I require daily medication. I was able to bring some medication with me, but not enough to cover my stay here. After much research on different hospitals and clinics in Chiang Mai, I decided to visit CM Mediclinic …

Visited for our final dose of some travel vaccines a couple of weeks ago. I’m not that comfortable with vaccinations, but the staff were superb here and really made it as easy (probably easier) than doing it in my home country. Would thoroughly recommend CM Mediclinic to travellers.
Thank you for your responsiveness by email and your kindness on site. The welcome and care were perfect. Thanks again.

Excellent first time visit.
I needed an ECG done.
Staff was very friendly and professional.
The clinic was very modern and clean.
I had a scheduled appointment and it was held with no delay.
This had all been arranged online with the clinic responding very quickly to my questions and requests.
The PDF of the ECG was sent within two hours to my email .
Outstanding experience.
First rate clinic with very  areasonable price.
Thank you.

Great clinic! Went here for my second dose of rabies vaccine, nice aircon. Kind workers and all went very quickly. I think this is the less painful vaccine ive everhad haha no pain at all which is great! Thankyou

Great first experience.
Needed to get bloodwork of all sorts, in & out within 20min.
First rate experience - was told to expect results emailed within a day or two (even on weekends)! Fastest so far of all clinics I have went to - and one of the cheapest too.
Got in same day for an ear infection, very helpful and well priced

Had to go and get a med cert for foreign work permits and this clinic was the nearest I saw. The clinic was clean, accommodating and they spoke in perfect English. Quick to check-up, doctor was knowledgeable too. Highly recommended.

Very impressed with Dr. Hawkins and her team (the nurse and the receptionist). What a fantastic trio!
First off, the clinic is spotless and well-organized. Dr. Hawkins is knowledgeable and has great bedside manner — everything you want in a doctor. Everyone is super professional while being empathetic and kind at the same time. The fees and resonable, especially given the quality of service. You can tell this clinic strives for excellence. Will continue going there as long as I live in CM.

Very prompt in response, I needed a IMOJEV vaccination, I booked it in the morning and had it done by 3pm!
I came in soaking wet because of the flash rain and they were incredibly accommodating.
I would recommend this place to my friends and family! 10/10

Great service. Went for a routine blood test before a flight and was in and out of the clinic in under half an hour. Staff were friendly and lovely and helped out so much with my results being received on the same day. Highly recommend!
Incredible service, great pricing for vaccines, and was very grateful that they speak English. Thank you so much!

I had a fantastic experience. The booking and testing process was seamless and efficient and I received my results less than 24 hours later. Staff are friendly and speak some of the best English I've heard in the city. Highly recommended.

Excellent service and price.
I got my rabies vaccine and the staff was fast and professional.

Lovely experience. Needed a walk in and although they were busy they gave a very accurate time I'd need to wait. Doctor was very thorough in explanation. Receptionist was very kind and friendly. And the price of consultation and meds were very reasonable! Great option of you find yourself a bit sick on your holiday

My partner needed to see a doctor during our time in Chiang Mai
We booked CM based on the reviews and it didn’t disappoint.
The clinic is clean, the staff were friendly and the doctor was easy to understand and extremely helpful

Female doctor is very friendly and professional, and speaks excellent English. Explained in detail what’s wrong and what the next steps are. Female nurse is very careful and friendly too. Excellent experience, would recommend.
I went to this clinic for a medical travel letter. I found both the doctor and receptionist to be helpful and professional.

Extremely professional, clean, efficient and capable clinic. Not to mention very affordable as well. Doctor speaks flawless English and is extremely knowledgeable on a wide range of topics. She’s also very kind and makes you feel very …

Really fast response and very good communication in English. I got an appointment for the next morning and my test results were arriving by mail one day later already. I was really greatful to have gotten an appointment so quickly. The only improvement I would suggest (I can only speak for my case) that I didn’t have a consultation with the doctor first. Instead, I was proposed a package of tests by mail on the previous day which I agreed to and which were then conducted (general checks, urine and blood). From doctors back home in Germany I’m used to consultations. However, the doctor made a few minutes time after the tests were performed for some oral exchange and gave good advice on further tests I could perform in the hospital. Communication after my health check up was also good and I received a consultation letter by mail upon request for my insurance.

Woke up one day with some inner ear pain. Easy to make an appointment, very good English communication. Very comfortable establishment, the doctor was very knowledgeable and took the time to inform me about the details and differences between various types of ear infections and the range of severity and causes of each, giving me a great understanding and comfortability with my current experience and ailment. The visit was swift, and I received my medicine at the office before leaving. Very reasonable pricing, I highly recommend to anybody hesitant to go see a doctor while traveling. This was a great experience, and if they cannot help, they are very nice and will definitely provide information to get you to someone who can. Thank you so much!
Came for my TRT blood test and came way early. Waited maybe 15 mins then they drew the blood which took all of maybe 5 minutes and I went home. Very clean office and everyone speaks perfect English

Excellent service. I walked in 15 minutes before closing time without an appointment and the doctor still managed to see me. The nice female doctor speaks excellent English. The place is impeccably clean, bright and modern. I was diagnosed …

Very professional and courteous clinic, offering a wide selection of medicines and prophylactics. Were very patient with me when I forget my card and had to return home to get it after having already received a billable treatment. The receptionist, Fai, was very welcoming and pleasant to talk to, and her English was so good that I could almost have been speaking with a native English speaker. She and her fellows there created calm and easy atmosphere around what could be an unnerving procedure for some.
Thanks for a great service 🙏🏻

I went to this clinic to check my ears as I suffered from Airplane Ear symptoms during my flight to Chang Mai. I made an online appointment (they won’t accept walk-in patients due to the high volume of patients) and received the …

Prior to arriving in Chiang Mai, CM Mediclinic corresponded with me professionally, quickly, and in clear and perfect English.  They explained everything very clearly on making an appointment as well as the costs of the visit/treatment.  On …

The best clinic ever. Me and my partner has been seeing Dr.Hawkins for many years.
She is very considerate and professional, Also her staffs. they provided excellent services. the price is very reasonable. There is no complaint.

The clinic is highly professional and well-run, while still being warm and friendly. I came for routine skin wound dressings after suffering an injury in my home country, and the treatment that I have received so far in this clinic has been more than satisfactory. Prices are very reasonable as well, and don't differ much from prices in my home country of Korea (which is well-known for cheap and reliable healthcare).

The nurse who has been providing my skin wound dressings has been lovely, and is very highly skilled. My skin wounds have become noticeably better in a short time period, thanks to her.

I can't recommend this place enough.  The doctor spent the time to answer all of my questions thoroughly and she seems to really care for her patients.  I probably ask too many questions, but she never made me feel rushed.  All the answers make sense, and she speaks perfect English.  She makes complex information understandable which helps me  to actually follow her advice.  The receptionist is also very welcoming and helpful.  I actually thought she might have been the doctor because she also seems to have medical training which set me at ease that I was in competent hands.  The prices are very affordable for how valuable the information is and it's just a super easy process to schedule an appointment and get EXACTLY the information you want without any hassle.

text:
Very friendly and clean clinic! We did our second shot of rabies vaccine here, cost us the same as the first dose did in Bangkok - in other words, the clinic is fairly priced. Quick and easy vaccination appointment.

The staff was sweet, spoke and understood english. The clinic itself is small and has a warm and professional atmosphere.

We will come back to this clinic if we are in need of more health services!

I did a health check at CM medi clinic this morning and I highly recommend this place.  The person in charge of scheduling the appointment was very responsive and they were flexible with the dates . The clinic is small and clean and the test was done quickly,  no waiting time. They emailed me the results the same day with detailed explanations about them which is really useful.
Thank you CM medi clinic team for the quality of your service.

Exceptional service from Dr. Hawkins and her team. They run a tight ship, almost no waiting time in between the receptionist, the nurse, and the doctor. Dr. Hawkins and her team are super friendly, they communicate really well English, and they went the extra mile to make sure I understood everything.

I made an urgent appointment and it was confirmed immediately. The people at the clinic are super friendly and professional and they speak English fluently. The doctor gave me the better prescription I could get and she was very professional. I would 100% recommend it.
Really a great place, very friendly staff and competent Doctor and good prices!! 👏🏼 …

Very clean and organized clinic. You'll get an itemized bill for services rendered. I had visited other doctors in Chiang Mai, and they don't give an itemized bill. Even the dentist in Chiang Mai don't give me a bill. All in all, best to book an appointment by their website.
Very quick and easy test can be done here. The place is very pleasant and the people are quite friendly. Easily get a COVID test done here before any travel.

I received excellent care here. It was very easy to book an online appointment. Communication was top notch with Dr. Jittiya  as well as all the staff I encountered. Reception very welcoming. Would highly recommend. Walking distance to Maya area.
The doctor was professional and very patient throughout.   I must have interrupted her many times with trivial questions but she slowly and patiently answered them all. …

Great clinic! I went 2x without an appointment and they helped me almost immediately. The (small) clinic is modern and clean with only female staff. The doctor is very kind and gives you honest advise. Prices are fair and results are quick. I felt very comfortable here.

Very professional and concise. The longest waiting time I had out of all the procedure was for my blood samples to be done testing. The rest goes quickly and would highly recommend for its pricing and packages.
Very good service.
The service was good and very fast. The place was clean.
Wonderful service,quick and easy.warm staff 💜 …
The clinic is clean and the staff are very attentive.
Fast service, great staff. Nam was so nice and helpful
Always attentive, accommodating, and polite. A highly recommended clinic.

It was a relief to find this doctor—a jovial British man named Jeremy—who could personally relate to my erectile dysfunction, having faced similar issues due to being slightly overweight and over 50. He recommended a medication based on his own experience that worked extremely well, and also shared helpful advice and practical tips, including guidance on where to find tools and toys in CM help to improve performance.

My only minor complaint was that the perinium massage cream was a bit expensive, though he reassured me that, in his experience, it was worth the cost.
This was my first time receiving treatment here, and I was very impressed. The doctor was kind, polite, attentive to detail, and provided thorough advice.
This was my first time at this clinic. The doctor asked about my symptoms and gave very good advice. It didn't take long.
Fast and professional services

I needed my second rabies booster shot, so I went to the clinic the day before and asked if I could get an appointment as early as possible the next day, as we had a long bus trip ahead of us. The receptionist gave me an appointment at 9:15 a.m., which worked out perfectly. Everyone at the clinic is very friendly and helpful; I felt very comfortable and would definitely come back. Thank you so much! ☺️

A good clinic. I had blood tests. You can request a price list via email.
Complete blood count - 200 baht
Total testosterone - 630 baht
Estradiol - 600 baht
Results within a day.

Excellent service, blood test results back within 24hrs.
Thanks very much.
Good people and great prices
Always great service here. I highly recommend. Been coming for many years
Professional and clean clinic
Went there for a medical certificate for my driver's license. Very friendly (english speaking) staff, very fast process (15 min) and very helpful related to all my questions :)
Very efficient, did not wait long to be seen by the doctor

Great experience.
Superb doctor. Took all the time needed to listen and to explain.
All the other reviews say theres no wait! I waited 30 mins even though I made an appointment. Otherwise great experience getting a few travel vaccines
It was so good and fast experience
Went in for a medical certificate for work. The service was quick and the clinic is very clean. Very nice staff too. Highly recommended!
Clean environment, thorough workers, responsive reception and perfect English for foreigners.
This Clinic I would recommend to absolutely anybody. Wonderful people. ENGLISH SPEAKING. Kind, considerate and understanding. Can't recommend highly enough.

The service was absolutely amazing! The best service ever!
The doctor was so kind, explained everything in detail, and gave great advice. I've never met a doctor like this before. Thank you so much!
Good service, polite staff

text: Unfortunately, I was scratched by a stray cat and was advised to undergo the rabies vaccination cycle. At this clinic, I found a kind doctor who explained everything to me and guided me through the vaccination process. A professional clinic with reasonable costs.

The service was good and fast. The doctor and nurses were well-equipped. I had my appendectomy wound cleaned for 260 baht, a reasonable price. The clinic was clean. You need to book an appointment in advance. I called at 9 am to ask if they …
Super friendly and attentive staff. They were very quick and efficient and there was no endless waiting. Highly recommend!
Amazing service, very efficient and friendly. The doctor is amazing!
Clean, polite, friendly, and quick!
Very professional and reasonably priced.  Also excellent signage to find the clinic!
